messages.body_plain:
Dear AndrÃ©

it should not make any difference as long as all loci have the same ploidy.
If not, then I would recommend using frequencies to avoid over-weighting
loci with higher ploidy.

Best
Thibaut

messages.body_plain:
For genind objects, this is done automatically (under the hood, scaleGen
scales allele frequencies). If you use 'tab()' to extract allelic profiles,
just use tab(freq = TRUE) to get frequencies.

Best
Thibaut
